help.title: About Sales & handover
help.overview: These are company-wide switches for how new sales are approved and when a handover date may be recorded. There is one settings record per company — not a list of sales. Saving here does not create a sale or a handover package.

sections.title: What the switches do
items: Require manager approval when creating a sale — new sales start pending approval. The unit is still marked sold immediately. Approving keeps it sold. Rejecting returns the unit to available and clears the sale on the unit.

Require a completed handover package before recording handover — the first time you set a handover date on a sale, that unit must already have a completed handover package. Changing an existing handover date later is not blocked by this gate.
sections.body: Both default off. Turning a switch on does not rewrite historical sales. It applies to the next sale you create and to the next first handover date you stamp.

sections.title: On this page
items: The page opens this company’s single settings record (created automatically if it did not exist).
There is no create, delete, or per-project override here.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: With approval off, creating a sale notifies as created — there is no pending queue.
With approval on, the seller is notified that approval is pending; managers decide on the Sales page.
Handover packages are assembled on the unit / sales flow. This page only gates stamping the handover date.
Changing these flags does not cancel sales that are already pending.

sections.title: Related records
items: Sales — approve or reject, and record handover / title transfer.
Units — sold versus available after a reject.
Handover packages — must be completed on the unit before the first handover date when the second switch is on.
